thick bakery style chocolate chip cookies🍪🍫 Ingredients: 170g (3/4 cup) unsalted butter, cold and cubed 150g (3/4 cup) brown sugar 70g (1/3 cup) granulated sugar 1 egg + 1 egg yolk 2 tsp vanilla 300g (2 1/2 cups) all purpose flour 1 tbsp cornstarch 1/2 tsp baking soda 1/4 tsp baking powder 3/4 tsp salt 250g (1 1/2 cups) chocolate chips  Flakey sea salt (optional) Instructions:  1. In a large bowl, combine the butter, brown sugar, and white sugar. Mix until smooth and well combined. Do not cream. 2. Add the egg, egg yolk, and vanilla, then mix until fully incorporated. 3. Add the dry ingredients (flour, cornstarch, baking powder, baking soda, and salt) and fold until just combined. 4. Fold in the chocolate chips or chunks until evenly distributed. Do not overmix. 5. Divide the dough into 150g portions and shape each into a rough ball. 6. Place the dough balls on a lined tray, cover, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or overnight. 7. Bake in a preheated 190°C (375°F) oven for 13-16 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the centers are still slightly soft. 8. Allow the cookies to cool on the baking tray for a few minutes, then transfer to a wire rack. If desired, sprinkle with flaky sea salt and let cool for about 15 minutes before serving. Enjoy! Note: This recipe made 6 cookies weighing 150g each and 1 cookie weighing 100g🍪🤎 #baking #cookies #chocolatechipcookies #Recipe #nyccookies

📚Build a Study Schedule That Actually Works 1. Count the weeks until your exam, then divide your syllabus across those weeks. Know your pace. 2. Build buffer weeks into your schedule — life happens. Flexible plans survive, rigid ones collapse. 3. Assign subjects to specific days: don't try to cover all subjects daily. Batch by subject for depth. 4. Schedule review sessions BEFORE new content — start each week by reviewing the previous week first. 5. Your peak energy hours should be reserved for hardest subjects. Schedule light review for low-energy times. 6. Review your study schedule every Sunday. What worked? What didn't? Adjust and move forward. #StudyTok #StudyMotivation #ExamPrep #StudyHacks #StudyWithMe

Make a catch-up plan: list all missing work, rank by exam weight, tackle the highest-value items first. 3. Don't try to catch up on everything in one day. Catch up on one unit today, then another tomorrow. 4. Ask a teacher, lecturer, or classmate to briefly explain what you missed. Humility accelerates catch-up. 5. Reduce social time temporarily — a 2-week social sacrifice can recover a month of missed content. 6. Forgive yourself for falling behind. Then use that energy to move forward. “고(故) 하용조 목사 “네 믿음대로 될지어다” 예수님은 누구를 만나든 동일하게 말씀하셨습니다. 향유 담은 옥합을 가지고 와서 눈물로 예수님의 발을 적시며 향유를 부은 여인에게 주님은 말씀하셨습니다. “네 믿음이 너를 구원하였느니라.” (누가복음 7:50) 여리고 성에서 “다윗의 자손 예수여, 나를 불쌍히 여기소서!” 외치던 소경에게도 주님은 말씀하셨습니다. “네 믿음이 너를 구원하였느니라.” (누가복음 18:42) 12년 동안 혈루증으로 고통받던 여인이 예수님의 옷자락을 만졌을 때, 주님은 말씀하셨습니다. “딸아, 네 믿음이 너를 구원하였으니 평안히 가라.” (누가복음 8:48) 귀신 들린 딸을 둔 가나안 여인에게도 주님은 말씀하셨습니다. “여자여 네 믿음이 크도다 네 소원대로 되리라.” (마태복음 15:28) 모두에게 한결같이 하신 말씀은 이것입니다. “네 믿음대로 될지어다.” (마태복음 9:29, 8:13) 여러분, 하나님의 영광을 보고 싶습니까. 기적을 경험하고 싶습니까. 그렇다면 믿으십시오. 믿음을 표현하십시오. 결단하십시오. 행동하십시오. 비록 의지가 부족하고 실수가 많을지라도, 그 믿음을 하나님께 드리면 주님께서 오늘도 말씀하십니다. “네 믿음대로 될지어다.” #믿음 #기도 #간증 #예수님 #찬송

Ooey-Gooey Scoopable Nutella Cookie Pie🤤 Yields: 15-16 Chunky Cookies INGREDIENTS:  230g Cold Chopped Unsalted Butter  160g Caster Sugar  160g Light Brown Sugar  450g Chocolate Chunks or chips  475g Plain Flour  1 tsp Salt 3 tsp Baking Powder  3/4 tsp Baking Soda  2 Eggs  1 Egg Yolk  1 tsp Vanilla  INSTRUCTIONS: •Cut cling wrap into small squares. Scoop ½ teaspoon Nutella onto individual cling-wrap squares. Fold to seal and freeze until solid. (Repeat for however many Nutella stuffed cookies you plan to make.) •In a large mixing bowl, add the cold cubed butter and whisk until slightly creamy. Add the white sugar and light brown sugar, then whisk together until well combined and fluffy. •Add the eggs, vanilla extract, and chocolate chips or chunks. Whisk until fully incorporated. •Add the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Gently mix until just combined, do not overmix. •Portion the dough into 90g balls. Press a frozen Nutella piece into the centre of each dough ball, seal well, and roll into a smooth ball. •Place the stuffed cookie dough balls onto a tray and freeze for at least 30 minutes (or overnight for best results). •Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F). •Take any shape baking dish circle, square, rectangle anything and line it with parchment paper. Arrange frozen cookie dough balls in it leaving some space between them. •Bake for 10-15 minutes (timing depends on the type of pan) or until the tops are lightly golden while the centres remain soft and gooey. •Remove from the oven and let cool slightly. •Serve warm with ice cream and chocolate sauce enjoy!✨ NOTE: Store any extra dough balls in an airtight container or freezer bag and freeze for later. Whenever a cookie craving hits, bake straight from frozen🫶🏻 #cookie #nutella #cookiepie #fyp #viral
